other_conditions: Applicant must be of Kerala origin.
Applicant must have qualified the Higher Secondary Examination in Kerala.
Applicant must have secured minimum 90% marks overall and in all science subjects (or minimum 80% for SC/ST candidates).
Applicant must have secured admission to a 3‑year B.Sc., 5‑year Integrated M.Sc. or Integrated BS‑MS program in basic or natural sciences at any Indian institution/university.
Selection is based on aggregate marks in science subjects of the Higher Secondary Examination.
At least 50% of scholarship seats are reserved for female students.
A minimum of 75% marks in the undergraduate course is required to continue the scholarship for postgraduate studies.
benefits_summary: Provides scholarship amounts ranging from ₹12,000 to ₹60,000 per year for undergraduate and postgraduate studies in basic/natural sciences, along with opportunities for science enrichment programmes and internships.
